previous_versions.body:
@elarlang thank you for the link on previous discussion and for explanation what is the case behind of the requirement description.  
And I got what slightly confused me... 

What do you think if we change wording a little, just avoid confusion with "input which"?
From
> Verify that files uploaded or generated by untrusted input **which are** stored in a public folder, are not executed as server-side program code when accessed directly with an HTTP request.

to
> Verify that files uploaded or generated by untrusted input **and** stored in a public folder are not executed as server-side program code when accessed directly with an HTTP request.
